training: Four preceding seasons; cutoff before first kickoff of each slate; six-hour completion buffer.
selectionLimit: Retained-result model selection, not an untouched prospective test. Seven alternatives were screened on these same seasons.
screening: First four alternatives vary carryover (4/1, 4/.9, 6/.9, 2/.9). Next two remove margin residual downweighting (4/.9, 2/.9). Final comparison isolates removal at the winning 4/1 carryover. Labels encode prior games and season retention.

reasons: Aggregate margin MAE did not improve.
Joint margin and Brier improvement did not win most seasons.
